payload.posture: Read Acts 1:1–5 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states luke recalls Jesus’ teaching and resurrection appearances, then reports his command to wait in Jerusalem for the Father’s promise and baptism in the Holy Spirit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
